ns2:course.label: Advanced Topics in Preservation & Tech Services
ns2:course.description: Variety of newly developed and advanced topics courses within the fields of Preservation & Tech Services, intended to augment the existing Information Sciences curricula. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. May be repeated in the same or separate semesters to a maximum of 16 hours, if topics vary.
